messages:
ash_k: Quick idea — can we add a tiny per-invocation "cost preview" that shows token cost + cache-credit applied?
ash_k: Right now the dashboard shows aggregate cache savings but it's hard to explain a single spike in a tenant's bill.
maria_r: Yeah, customers ask: did our prefetches or kv-cache save them money this hour or cost us extra?
kevinw: If we expose per-request credits we need a deterministic rule for attribution. otherwise it's going to be confusing.
ash_k: Agreed. Proposal: lightweight API that returns {unit_cost, cache_credit, model_sku} for a request id. Not for billing, just for preview/console.
ash_k: Example payload sketch:
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_12345",
  "model_sku": "redwood-3b-q4",
  "tokens": 128,
  "unit_cost": 0.00192,
  "cache_credit": 0.00048,
  "final_cost": 0.00144,
  "reason": "kv-prefetch hit (prefix cached)"
}
```
sam-platform: love the idea. keeps billing canonical but gives ops a debuggable signal. also useful for canary rollouts to see model-sku cost diffs.
maria_r: UX idea: show a small badge on the invocation row: ":sparkles: -$0.00048" and a hover with breakdown (prefetch vs kv vs batching). toggle to show/hide credits across tenant.
kevinw: Two concerns: data volume and privacy. We should sample — only compute preview for 1% by default and up to 100% when customer enables debug mode.
ash_k: yep sampling + cached rollups. Also cache_credit should be amortized: prefetches that saved many requests should spread credit back to the originating prefetcher rather than the first hit only.
sam-platform: that amortization is tricky for UI. maybe display both: immediate credit and amortized view. customers can switch.
maria_r: we also need routing implications. If sticky routing moves a tenant to a cheaper region/model, previews must show the route decision's delta.
ash_k: good call — include a field "route_delta": {"alt_model_sku":"redwood-3b-fp16","alt_cost":0.0022} in the preview.
kevinw: For telemetry: add trace_id and cache_fingerprint so we can tie preview to logs and reproductions. also store a 7d sample for debugging.
ash_k: infra-bot — can we get a quick estimate on CPU/GPU for computing previews at 1% sampling?
infra-bot: @channel provisioning estimate: ~0.5 vCPU per 1000 req/s if previews computed inline. We recommend async preview jobs to reduce tail latency. :robot_face:
maria_r: Async + eventual consistency sounds right. preview can show "estimated" immediately and a final number when job completes.
sam-platform: rollout plan idea: feature-flagged in Console -> Beta customers opt-in -> collect feedback -> gradually increase sampling.
kevinw: For canaries: add a compare toggle that overlays costs for current canary vs baseline using same sampled requests. helps show unit-econ regressions.
ash_k: Action items: (1) infra to prototype async preview job and storage sampling (2) kevin to draft attribution rules (immediate vs amortized) (3) ux to mock inline badge + compare-view.
maria_r: I'll sketch the hover microcopy to make "cache_credit" understandable to non-ML PMs.
ash_k: Great. if no objections I'll file a tiny RFC and put a canary ticket in the console backlog.
kevinw: +1 on RFC. keep the API read-only and non-bill-affecting.
sam-platform: +1. also add telemetry tags: preview_sample, preview_version.
ash_k: thanks all. I'll spin up the RFC draft and ping owners. :raised_hands:
